name: PVC Honeycomb Perforated Mats
description:
Maximum Drainage, Anti-Slip Safety, and All-Weather Durability

Keep your wet areas safe, hygienic, and slip-free with our premium PVC Honeycomb Pattern Mats. Featuring a classic perforated hollow design, these mats are engineered specifically for environments where water, mud, or moisture accumulate. The open honeycomb cells allow water and liquid to drain through instantly, leaving the standing surface dry, clean, and safe to walk on.

Whether you need a heavy-duty doormat to scrape off mud before entering your house, a safe walking surface for a swimming pool deck, or a non-slip floor for a busy commercial bathroom, our honeycomb mats deliver high performance.

Ideal Applications & Use Cases
Bathrooms & Wet Areas: Prevent dangerous slips on slick shower floors, changing rooms, and executive washrooms.

Doorsteps & Entrances: Act as a heavy-duty scraper to trap large dirt particles, stones, and mud from shoes before they enter your pristine rooms.

Outdoor & Poolside: Highly resistant to sunlight and water, making them perfect for swimming pool edges, verandas, and balconies.

Commercial Kitchens & Car Washes: Give staff a secure, elevated grip on floors prone to grease, soap, and standing water.

Key Features & Specifications
Vibrant Color Options: Brighten up or seamlessly blend your matting into your current decor. Available in striking, high-visibility colors: Red, Green, Blue, and Grey.

Premium PVC Construction: Made from high-grade, flexible vinyl that doesn't crack under heavy foot traffic or curl at the edges.

Excellent Foot Cushioning: The resilient hollow structure offers a comfortable, anti-fatigue surface for areas where people stand for long periods.

Effortless Cleaning: Simply lift the mat, sweep away the drained debris underneath, and hose the mat down with water. It dries almost instantly!

Seamless Delivery Across Kenya (Pay on Delivery)
Pay on Delivery (Nairobi): Shop with 100% confidence. If you are ordering within Nairobi, inspect the honeycomb mat pattern and color quality at your location and pay only upon delivery.

Countrywide Fast Shipping: We cut, pack, and dispatch your mats daily via trusted courier networks straight to your doorstep anywhere in Kenya.
